scope: Read-only Codex technical review, not human approval or independent gold review
retained_risks: Readonly prediction is not permanent event ownership; platform rechecks current context
Core revision and candidate ID require platform session and epoch binding
Unknown does not map to NotApplied and cannot trigger automatic retry
Escape or focus cancellation does not prove the document was not written
UTF-16 code-unit conversion guarantees scalar boundaries, not grapheme editing
Rust source contracts are not a stable cross-process ABI
Semantic external policy consistency proves neither human identity, rights nor cryptographic signature
